title: Another channeler also predicted the Challenger disaster

tellings.quote: afterwards I heard from them saying they knew of a another channeler somewhere who had made the same prediction.

plain: In 1986, a second channeler, meaning a person who claims to pass on messages from spirits or other beings, is said to have predicted the explosion of the Challenger space shuttle, just as another channeler had. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells it: after the disaster he heard from the Foundation for Mind Being Research, a group in the San Francisco Bay Area, that they knew of another channeler somewhere who had made the same prediction. If true, two separate people foretold the same event.
